name: 188. Compat convert params fits thinking budget per attempt (gemini fork) (convert params budget)
description: Compat should_convert_params (UI: Convert Unsupported Param Values) now fits the output cap AND the thinking budget per attempt, against the model each attempt reaches (fallbacks rerun the plugin, so each gets its own limits). A cap above the model ceiling is lowered; a caller-sent reasoning.max_tokens is scaled with it, clamped into the model's thinking-budget range, and kept under the cap. Red before: the plugin clamped max tokens to the catalog limit but set the budget one below it, above gemini-2.5-flash's 24576 maximum, so Bifrost's thinking-budget validation failed the request. Green after: maxOutputTokens at the catalog limit, thinkingBudget = 100000/1000000 of it (6553). Cases: (1) /v1/chat/completions, (2) /v1/responses, (3) a fallback attempt after an invalid primary model, fitted to the fallback's own limits. Enabled per request via x-bf-compat so the rows do not depend on the profile's compat config; x-bf-send-back-raw-request exposes the Gemini wire body.
